heroHeadline: Sovereign Key Enclaves for Autonomous AI Swarms
heroSubheadline: Eliminate cloud key leakage with Argon2id hardware encryption, local loopback RPC gates, and multi-agent peer arbitration.

features.title: Argon2id Enclave
features.desc: Hardware-backed cryptographic secret derivation with memory-hard zero-knowledge boundaries.

features.title: Loopback Zero-Egress
features.desc: Local-first IPC socket gates ensuring API keys never touch public network hops.

features.title: Swarm Peer Locks
features.desc: Decentralized state arbitration preventing race conditions across concurrent agent threads.

features.title: Real-Time Telemetry
features.desc: Microsecond latency telemetry with Shannon entropy agreement verification.

faqs.q: How does ApexVault secure API keys?
faqs.a: Keys are encrypted on disk with Argon2id and only held in RAM during active loopback transactions on 127.0.0.1.

faqs.q: Can I deploy the generated sites to any host?
faqs.a: Yes! All builds produce static HTML5/CSS/JS with zero runtime lock-in, deployable to Netlify, Vercel, Hostinger, or GitHub Pages.
